description: Scrape YouTube videos and Shorts by hashtag. Provide one or more hashtags to extract ranked videos, channel details, exact engagement counts, publish dates and more.

contentType.description: Which cards to return: regular videos, Shorts, or both.
contentType.title: Content Type

hashtags.description: Hashtags to scrape. Accepts a bare tag, a #tag, or a full youtube.com/hashtag/<tag> URL. Up to 200 unique tags per run.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

includeVideoDetails.description: Fetch each video's detail data to fill exact views, likes, comments, subscriber counts, publish date, description, keywords, category and Shorts channel metadata. Slower but more complete.
includeVideoDetails.title: Include Video Details

language.description: Language used for YouTube labels, counts and dates. Auto follows the selected market.
language.title: Language

market.description: Country/region used for the hashtag feed. It changes which videos rank and the default language.
market.title: Market / Region

maxResultsPerHashtag.description: Maximum records to return per hashtag after sorting and filters. YouTube's hashtag feed is a ranked sample, so large values may return fewer rows.
maxResultsPerHashtag.title: Max Results Per Hashtag

minViewCount.description: Drop videos with fewer than this many views. Turns on detail enrichment so compact Shorts labels are not mis-filtered.
minViewCount.title: Minimum View Count

publishedAfter.description: Only keep videos published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Turns on detail enrichment.
publishedAfter.title: Published After

sortBy.description: Order the collected results within each hashtag. Default keeps YouTube's first-seen feed order.
sortBy.title: Sort By

title: YouTube Hashtag Scraper Input
